title: luscious citrusy egyptian eggs frittata
description: a crispy and flavorful egyptian-inspired frittata bursting with citrusy flavors, perfect for a satisfying breakfast or brunch.
instructions: preheat the tandoor clay pot to 375 degrees fahrenheit.
roll out the laminated puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
in a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, lemon juice, orange juice, salt, and pepper.
add the sliced onion and minced garlic to the egg mixture and whisk until well combined.
spread the egg mixture evenly over the center of the puff pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
sprinkle the chopped parsley and dill over the egg mixture.
fold the 1-inch border over the filling to create a crust, pressing gently to seal.
place the frittata in the preheated tandoor clay pot and brush the egg wash over the pastry.
bake for 25-30 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown and the eggs are set.
remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
